messages.text: Your refund proposal is for **BRL 120.00**. Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; a typed “yes” won’t confirm it. A staff member will then review the request. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

continuation.content: Your refund proposal is for **BRL 120.00**. Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; a typed “yes” won’t confirm it. A staff member will then review the request. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

messages.text: Yes, that’s what I want. Actually, I’ve cancelled the refund request because my partner had already arranged a replacement with the seller. Will anything still be charged?

If you haven’t already used the **cancel button on the proposal card**, please do so—your chat message alone doesn’t cancel the request. I won’t proceed with payment while cancellation is unresolved. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

The refund policy doesn’t say whether a seller-arranged replacement carries any charge. Would you like a person to check that for you? (refund-policy/v2/exceptions)
